bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
pg='deploy-postgres-1'
test "$(docker inspect "$pg" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -A -F "|" -t -c "BEGIN READ ONLY; SELECT r.delivery_key,r.status,coalesce(array_to_string(r.free_message_ids,chr(44)),chr(45)),coalesce(r.paid_message_id,0),coalesce(l.price_stars,0),CASE WHEN l.paid_video_file_id IS NULL OR l.sample_file_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE l.paid_video_file_id=l.sample_file_id END, r.updated_at::date FROM videobot_post_receipts r LEFT JOIN videobot_listings l ON l.listing_id=r.listing_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 25; COMMIT;"'
